sentence: Using validated GC-EI-MS and 1H NMR methods, 47 tablet samples were quantified
uz: Validatsiyadan o‘tgan GC-EI-MS va 1H NMR usullari bilan 47 ta tabletka namunasi miqdoriy tahlil qilindi.
title: Bromazolam Tablet Quantification and Analysis of Post-Mortem Cases From the National Programme on Substance Use Mortality (NPSUM)

sentence: This study determined specific absorbance values for bromazolam, etizolam, flualprazolam, and flubromazepam using ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy in an aqueous acidic solution.
uz: Bu tadqiqotda bromazolam, etizolam, flualprazolam va flubromazepam uchun solishtirma yutilish (specific absorbance) qiymatlari suvli kislotali eritmada ultrabinafsha–ko‘rinadigan (UV-Vis) spektroskopiya yordamida aniqlandi.
title: Determination of specific absorbance (A¦) for four designer benzodiazepines

sentence: The standard addition method was employed to quantify flualprazolam in postmortem blood and tissues.
uz: O‘limdan keyingi qon va to‘qimalarda flualprazolamni miqdoriy aniqlash uchun standart qo‘shish usuli qo‘llanildi.
title: A case of fatal multidrug intoxication involving flualprazolam: distribution in body fluids and solid tissues

sentence: We describe an ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with tandem mass spectrometry method for the simultaneous quantification of methadone, morphine, oxycodone, hydrocodone, oxymorphone, hydromorphone and fentanyl in several tissues: liver, brain, kidney, abdominal adipose tissue, lung and blood plasma.
uz: Metadon, morfin, oksikodon, gidrokodon, oksimorfon, gidromorfon va fentanilni bir vaqtda miqdoriy aniqlash uchun jigar, bosh miya, buyrak, qorin yog‘ to‘qimasi, o‘pka va qon plazmasida ultra yuqori samarali suyuqlik xromatografiyasi–tandem mass-spektrometriya usuli tavsiflangan.
title: A Novel UHPLC-MS/MS Method for the Quantification of Seven Opioids in Different Human Tissues

sentence: In conclusion, Nitazene LFA test strips show potential value as preliminary material-based screening tools in forensic and harm-reduction applications, but should not be interpreted as confirmatory.
uz: Xulosa: nitazenlarga mo‘ljallangan lateral oqimli immunoanaliz (LFA) test-chiziqlari sud-ekspertiza va zararni kamaytirish sohasida moddaning o‘zini dastlabki skrining qilish vositasi sifatida qiymatga ega, ammo ularning natijasini tasdiqlovchi deb talqin qilmaslik kerak.
title: Decoding the Unseen: A Systematic Review of the Analytical Performance of Nitazene Test Strips for Identifying Synthetic Opioids in Seized Drug Materials

sentence: In this study, the 13 opioids morphine, oxycodone, codeine, O-desmethyl tramadol, ethylmorphine, tramadol, pethidine, ketobemidone, buprenorphine, fentanyl, cyclopropylfentanyl, etonitazepyne, and methadone were extracted from oral fluid using electromembrane extraction based on conductive vials prior to analysis with ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry.
uz: Bu tadqiqotda 13 ta opioid — morfin, oksikodon, kodein, O-desmetiltramadol, etilmorfin, tramadol, petidin, ketobemidon, buprenorfin, fentanil, siklopropilfentanil, etonitazepyne va metadon — og‘iz suyuqligidan o‘tkazuvchan flakonlarga asoslangan elektromembran ekstraksiya bilan ajratib olinib, so‘ng ultra yuqori samarali suyuqlik xromatografiyasi–tandem mass-spektrometriya bilan tahlil qilindi.
title: Conductive vial electromembrane extraction of opioids from oral fluid

sentence: In this paper, we developed a high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (HPLC-MS/MS) method to study simultaneously TDM and clinical pharmacokinetics of 23 antidepressants and active metabolites: sertraline, escitalopram, fluvoxamine, paroxetine, duloxetine, milnacipran, fluoxetine, venlafaxine, O-desmethylvenlafaxine, mirtazapine, trazodone, bupropion, hydroxybupropione, norfluoxetine, vortioxetine, agomelatine, mianserin, doxepine, desmethyldoxepin, clomipramine, desmethylclomipramine, amitriptyline and nortriptyline hydrochloride.
uz: Bu maqolada 23 ta antidepressant va faol metabolitni — sertralin, essitalopram, fluvoksamin, paroksetin, duloksetin, milnatsipran, fluoksetin, venlafaksin, O-desmetilvenlafaksin, mirtazapin, trazodon, bupropion, gidroksibupropion, norfluoksetin, vortioksetin, agomelatin, mianserin, doksepin, desmetildoksepin, klomipramin, desmetilklomipramin, amitriptilin va nortriptilin gidroxlorid — terapevtik dori monitoringi (TDM) va klinik farmakokinetika uchun bir vaqtda o‘rganish maqsadida yuqori samarali suyuqlik xromatografiyasi–tandem mass-spektrometriya (HPLC-MS/MS) usuli ishlab chiqildi.
title: High-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry for simultaneous determination of 23 antidepressants and active metabolites in human serum and its application in therapeutic drug monitoring

sentence: A mixture of methanol, ethylacetate, and 33% ammonia solution (6: 4: 0.2, by volume) was successfully utilized as a solvent system to separate the proposed components.
uz: Taklif etilgan komponentlarni (duloksetin va risperidon) ajratish uchun erituvchilar tizimi sifatida metanol, etilatsetat va 33% ammiak eritmasi aralashmasi (6 : 4 : 0,2, hajm bo‘yicha) muvaffaqiyatli qo‘llanildi.
title: A green TLC-densitometric bioanalytical method for concurrent determination of duloxetine and risperidone in human plasma with in-silico DDI evaluation

sentence: The resulting retardation factors (Rf) were 0.02, 0.32, 0.46 and 0.59 for plasma, DLX, PRP and RSP, respectively.
uz: Hosil bo‘lgan retardatsiya omillari (Rf) plazma, DLX (duloksetin), PRP (propranolol) va RSP (risperidon) uchun mos ravishda 0,02; 0,32; 0,46 va 0,59 bo‘ldi.
title: A green TLC-densitometric bioanalytical method for concurrent determination of duloxetine and risperidone in human plasma with in-silico DDI evaluation

sentence: This research targets to develop an environmentally harmonious, selective, and accurate TLC method to measure the levels of both DLX and RSP in spiked human plasma samples.
uz: Tadqiqot qo‘shilgan (spiked) inson plazmasi namunalarida DLX (duloksetin) va RSP (risperidon) miqdorini o‘lchash uchun ekologik jihatdan mos, tanlovchan va aniq TLC usulini ishlab chiqishga qaratilgan.
title: A green TLC-densitometric bioanalytical method for concurrent determination of duloxetine and risperidone in human plasma with in-silico DDI evaluation

sentence: In this work, we propose a novel methodology to screen eight SCs (AM-694, cumyl-5F-PINACA, MAM-2201, 5F-UR-144, JWH-018, JWH-122, UR-144 and APINACA) in oral fluids.
uz: Bu ishda og‘iz suyuqligida sakkizta sintetik kannabinoidni (SC: AM-694, cumyl-5F-PINACA, MAM-2201, 5F-UR-144, JWH-018, JWH-122, UR-144 va APINACA) skrining qilish uchun yangi uslub taklif etiladi.
title: Bar adsorptive microextraction and liquid chromatography-diode array detection of synthetic cannabinoids in oral fluid

sentence: A GC-MS method was developed and fully validated for the determination of furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil in whole blood.
uz: To‘liq qonda furanilfentanil va okfentanilni aniqlash uchun GC-MS usuli ishlab chiqildi va to‘liq validatsiyadan o‘tkazildi.
title: A GC-MS method for the determination of furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil in whole blood with full validation

sentence: The method included solid-phase extraction after protein precipitation using acetonitrile, and it was applied during the toxicological investigation of forensic cases.
uz: Usul atsetonitril yordamida oqsillarni cho‘ktirishdan keyingi qattiq fazali ekstraksiyani o‘z ichiga oladi va sud-tibbiy holatlarning toksikologik tekshiruvida qo‘llangan.
title: A GC-MS method for the determination of furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil in whole blood with full validation

sentence: The limit of detection and limit of quantification values were 0.30 and 1.0 ng/mL for furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil and 0.15 and 0.50 ng/mL for acetylfentanyl and butyrfentanyl, respectively.
uz: Aniqlash chegarasi (LOD) va miqdoriy aniqlash chegarasi (LOQ) qiymatlari furanilfentanil va okfentanil uchun 0,30 va 1,0 ng/mL, atsetilfentanil va butirfentanil uchun mos ravishda 0,15 va 0,50 ng/mL bo‘ldi.
title: A GC-MS method for the determination of furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil in whole blood with full validation

sentence: This method was also suitable for the determination of acetylfentanyl and butyrfentanyl.
uz: Bu usul atsetilfentanil va butirfentanilni aniqlash uchun ham yaroqli bo‘ldi.
title: A GC-MS method for the determination of furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil in whole blood with full validation

sentence: The limit of detection and limit of quantification values were 0.30 and 1.0 ng/mL for furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil and 0.15 and 0.50 ng/mL for acetylfentanyl and butyrfentanyl, respectively.
uz: Aniqlash chegarasi (LOD) va miqdoriy aniqlash chegarasi (LOQ) qiymatlari furanilfentanil va okfentanil uchun 0,30 va 1,0 ng/mL, atsetilfentanil va butirfentanil uchun mos ravishda 0,15 va 0,50 ng/mL bo‘ldi.
title: A GC-MS method for the determination of furanylfentanyl and ocfentanil in whole blood with full validation

sentence: We have thus established a detailed procedure for quantification of mepirapim and acetyl fentanyl in whole blood and urine specimens using gas chromatography (GC)-tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS).
uz: Shu tufayli mepirapim va atsetilfentanilni butun qon va siydik namunalarida gaz xromatografiyasi (GC)–tandem mass-spektrometriya (MS/MS) yordamida miqdoriy aniqlashning batafsil tartibi ishlab chiqildi.
title: Identification and quantification of mepirapim and acetyl fentanyl in authentic human whole blood and urine samples by GC-MS/MS and LC-MS/MS

sentence: The present study introduces an LC-MS/MS method for quantifying colchicine in human plasma.
uz: Bu tadqiqotda inson plazmasida kolxitsinni miqdoriy aniqlash uchun LC-MS/MS usuli taqdim etiladi.
title: Development and Validation of a Rapid and Simple UHPLC-MS/MS Method for the Determination of Colchicine in Human Plasma

sentence: Hyphenated techniques such as HPLC-ICP-MS and GC-ICP-MS have enabled significant advancements in mercury speciation analysis.
uz: HPLC-ICP-MS va GC-ICP-MS kabi birlashtirilgan (hyphenated) usullar simobning shakllarini (speciatsiya) tahlil qilishda sezilarli yutuqlarga imkon berdi.
title: Conventional Chromatographic Techniques and Biosensors for Mercury Speciation in Seafood: A Systematic Review

sentence: In PB at +4 °C, alcohols were measured by HS-GC/FID, drugs and narcotics by LC-HRMS, GHB by GC-MS and cannabinoids by LC-MS/MS.
uz: +4 °C da saqlangan periferik qonda (PB) spirtlar HS-GC/FID bilan, dori va giyohvand moddalar LC-HRMS bilan, GHB GC-MS bilan, kannabinoidlar esa LC-MS/MS bilan o‘lchandi.
title: Unusual Case of Fatal Virtual Chemsex Session Involving 3-Chloromethcathinone (3-CMC)

sentence: A systematic search of scientific databases was conducted to identify studies investigating GHB metabolites, conjugates, and related biochemical markers using advanced analytical techniques such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS.
uz: GHB metabolitlari, konyugatlari va tegishli biokimyoviy markerlarni LC-MS/MS va GC-MS kabi ilg‘or tahlil usullari bilan o‘rgangan tadqiqotlarni aniqlash uchun ilmiy ma’lumotlar bazalarida tizimli qidiruv o‘tkazildi.
title: Biomarkers of Gamma-Hydroxybutyric Acid (GHB) Exposure: A Comprehensive Review of Analytical and Forensic Advances

sentence: This study evaluated the performance of the Immunalysis Tapentadol 343 Urine Enzyme Immunoassay (EIA) screening kit, focusing on the prevalence of false-positive results due to cross-reactivity with tramadol.
uz: Bu tadqiqot Immunalysis Tapentadol 343 siydik fermentli immunoanaliz (EIA) skrining to‘plamining samaradorligini, xususan tramadol bilan o‘zaro reaksiya (kross-reaktivlik) tufayli yolg‘on musbat natijalar uchrashini baholadi.
title: Immunalysis tapentadol assay reformulation resolves tramadol interference

sentence: We recommend caution when interpreting positive tramadol urine screening among patients on fexofenadine treatment.
uz: Feksofenadin bilan davolanayotgan bemorlarda tramadolga musbat siydik skrining natijasini talqin qilishda ehtiyot bo‘lishni tavsiya etamiz.
title: False Positive Tramadol Urine Testing in Patients Taking Fexofenadine: A Tale of Two Consecutive Cases

sentence: This work addresses the detection and quantification of paracetamol (PAR) in human serum using a point-of-care approach, an essential assessment for intoxication cases in clinical analysis.
uz: Bu ish inson zardobida paratsetamolni (PAR) joyida tekshirish (point-of-care) usuli bilan aniqlash va miqdorini o‘lchashga bag‘ishlangan; bu klinik tahlilda zaharlanish holatlari uchun zarur baholashdir.
title: Rapid Point-of-Care Assessment of Paracetamol Intoxication via an Integrated Electrochemical-Colorimetric Method

sentence: This study proposes a portable and IoT-based electrochemical point-of-care sensing device for detecting zopiclone in cocktails.
uz: Bu tadqiqot kokteyllarda zopiklonni aniqlash uchun ko‘chma va IoT asosidagi elektrokimyoviy joyida tekshirish (point-of-care) qurilmasini taklif etadi.
title: Portable Miniaturized IoT-Enabled Point-of-Care Device for Electrochemical Sensing of Zopiclone in Cocktails

sentence: The veterinary sedative detomidine HCl caused false positives on all the strips at concentrations down to 0.07 mg/mL, and levamisole gave faint test lines (which can be misread as false positives) for almost all the strips at 2 mg/mL.
uz: Veterinariya sedativi detomidin HCl barcha chiziqlarda 0,07 mg/mL gacha bo‘lgan konsentratsiyada yolg‘on musbat natija berdi, levamizol esa 2 mg/mL da deyarli barcha chiziqlarda xira test chiziqlari berdi (ularni yolg‘on musbat deb noto‘g‘ri o‘qish mumkin).
title: Chiral sensitivity of medetomidine lateral flow immunoassay test strips

sentence: The performance of the SAMElife™ rapid hair screening kit was evaluated for the detection of drugs of abuse in 31 anonymized hair samples, encompassing 217 analyses for morphine, cocaine, amphetamines, buprenorphine, oxycodone, fentanyl, and methadone.
uz: SAMElife™ tezkor soch skrining to‘plamining giyohvandlik vositalarini aniqlashdagi samaradorligi 31 ta anonimlashtirilgan soch namunasida baholandi: morfin, kokain, amfetaminlar, buprenorfin, oksikodon, fentanil va metadon bo‘yicha jami 217 ta tahlil o‘tkazildi.
title: Evaluation of a rapid immunoenzymatic screening kit (SAMElife™) for drugs of abuse detection in hair

sentence: The performance of the SAMElife™ rapid hair screening kit was evaluated for the detection of drugs of abuse in 31 anonymized hair samples, encompassing 217 analyses for morphine, cocaine, amphetamines, buprenorphine, oxycodone, fentanyl, and methadone.
uz: SAMElife™ tezkor soch skrining to‘plamining giyohvandlik vositalarini aniqlashdagi samaradorligi 31 ta anonimlashtirilgan soch namunasida baholandi: morfin, kokain, amfetaminlar, buprenorfin, oksikodon, fentanil va metadon bo‘yicha jami 217 ta tahlil o‘tkazildi.
title: Evaluation of a rapid immunoenzymatic screening kit (SAMElife™) for drugs of abuse detection in hair
